expectations.text: Uses resource() to fetch dropdown options based on category signal
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:94 uses `rxResource` with old `request` property instead of `params` — TypeScript error TS2769. Uses rxResource instead of resource().

expectations.text: Uses linkedSignal with object syntax (source + computation + previous) to preserve valid selection
expectations.evidence: No linkedSignal imported or used. Selection preservation is done via effect() in constructor (lines 132-149) — the exact anti-pattern warned against in Angular docs.

expectations.text: Uses computed() for derived display string
Uses custom equality function ({equal: fn}) on at least one signal
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:88 has `signal<string>('', { equal: (a, b) => a === b })` but this is trivially identical to the default string equality (Object.is). Not a meaningful custom equality.

expectations.text: Does NOT use effect() to sync selection state
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:132-149 uses effect() to watch options changes and set selectedId — this is the state propagation anti-pattern.
